items.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.why: Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash, offering a high-speed AI model you can use via API.
items.summary: Gemini 3.7 Flash is Google's newest speed-optimized language model for developer applications. It balances quick response times with lower API costs for building real-time AI features.

items.title: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
items.why: DeepSeek released an official harness framework that lets you build and extend modular AI plugins easily.
items.summary: This open-source project provides a plugin architecture for DeepSeek models, allowing developers to extend AI capabilities. It gives you a structured foundation to build custom AI workflows and tools.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B
items.why: Alibaba released a major updated open model in their popular Qwen LLM family.
items.summary: Qwen 3.8 27B is an open-weights language model optimized for coding and complex reasoning tasks. It provides a strong open-source option for running models locally or integrating into custom apps.

items.title: Leutenegger/book-to-skill
items.why: You can convert programming books or documentation into custom knowledge tools for AI coding assistants.
items.summary: A practical tool that turns technical book PDFs into structured skills for Claude Code. This enables your AI assistant to reference concepts directly from textbooks while helping you write code.

items.title: 0xnyn/airship
items.why: It provides a visual, Figma-like editor interface for interactive AI coding tools like Claude Code.
items.summary: Airship brings a graphical design canvas to command-line AI coding assistants. It helps developers inspect, visualize, and steer automated code editing tasks.

items.title: shadcn-ui/chatbot-template
items.why: If you want to build a modern AI chat web application, this template gives you a full starter codebase.
items.summary: A minimal chatbot template built with Next.js, Vercel AI SDK, and modern UI components. It helps you quickly deploy a working web chat interface connected to AI services.

items.title: antirez/h3.c
items.why: Written by the creator of Redis, this small C engine shows how fast AI model inference is built from scratch.
items.summary: A lightweight C-based engine designed to run the MiniMax H3 language model on Mac computers. It serves as an accessible open-source codebase for learning efficient LLM execution.

items.title: vercel-labs/eve-software-factory-template
items.why: This template from Vercel Labs demonstrates how to structure automated AI agent workflows for building software.
items.summary: An open-source starter kit for creating automated software development pipelines powered by AI agents. It gives developers a real-world project structure for experimenting with AI code generation.

items.title: AI by Hand
items.why: Working through neural network concepts step-by-step by hand is one of the best ways to build intuitive understanding.
items.summary: A beginner-friendly educational series that visually breaks down fundamental machine learning algorithms using manual calculations. It helps you grasp underlying math concepts without getting lost in code.

items.title: SaladDay/pi-from-scratch
items.why: Building a mini AI agent from scratch in TypeScript is a clear, hands-on way to learn how agents work.
items.summary: A simplified AI agent written in roughly 600 lines of TypeScript code. It serves as a step-by-step tutorial for early-stage programmers wanting to understand AI agent internals.

items.title: Appllama/top-welcome-screens
items.why: Studying how real mobile apps build user onboarding screens is a great way to improve your UI skills.
items.summary: A collection of 10 animated mobile welcome screens inspired by top iOS apps, recreated using React Native and Expo. It provides clear sample code for learning cross-platform mobile frontend development.

items.title: Trump says he will declare Strait of Hormuz a US ‘territory’ amid Iran war
items.why: Tensions surrounding this strategic global shipping channel represent a key development in international news.
items.summary: US leadership announced intentions to claim jurisdiction over the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil transit route. The statement comes amid ongoing conflict and volatile negotiations with Iran.

items.title: From Europe to Asia, floods to heatwaves, world experiences weather shocks
items.why: It gives you a brief global overview of severe weather events occurring simultaneously across continents.
items.summary: Extreme weather shocks are causing disruptions worldwide, including fatal flooding in Japan and severe heatwaves across Europe. Emergency workers are struggling with power grid outages and widespread wildfires.
